रॉबर्ट पैटिंसन को आधिकारिक तौर पर नया जेम्स बॉन्ड 007 चुन लिया गया है। 🎬
उन्होंने निकोलस हॉल्ट और जैक लाउडेन जैसे कलाकारों को पीछे छोड़कर यह बड़ा किरदार अपने नाम किया है। 🌟
यह शानदार एंट्री डेनियल क्रेग के इस फ्रेंचाइजी से विदाई लेने के पूरे 5 साल बाद हुई है। 🕶️
क्या आप रॉबर्ट पैटिंसन को जेम्स बॉन्ड के रूप में देखने के लिए तैयार हैं? 💥

ctx.title: Robert Pattinson is Officially James Bond 007, beats Nicholas Hoult, Jack Lowden; Arrives 5 Years After Daniel Craig’s Departure
ctx.summary:
Robert Pattinson has been enjoying a dream career run with major projects such as Dune, The Odyssey, and The Batman. Now, the actor appears to be stepping into another iconic role, as he is confirmed as the next James Bond following Daniel Craig's departure in 2021. 
 Robert Pattinson is Officially James Bond 
 A new update shared by the official James Bond 007 social media handle has sparked speculation, featuring a glimpse of  Robert Pattinson  in a suave new avatar. The video shows the actor holding a firearm while sporting the stylish appearance associated with the iconic character. 
 Check it out here: 
     The upcoming film will be directed by Dune filmmaker  Denis Villeneuve , who was confirmed to helm the project last year. Meanwhile, Peaky Blinders creator Steven Knight has penned the screenplay. 
 As per Rolling Stones, Pattinson said, “One of the most legendary characters in cinema, and securing the role was the honor of a lifetime. To say this role is a dream come true is an understatement. I couldn’t be more excited about this partnership and the work ahead with this fantastic team.” 
 Robert Pattinson's casting makes him the seventh actor to portray James Bond in the official film franchise. Sean Connery was the first to play the iconic 007, appearing in six films, including Dr. No, Goldfinger, Thunderball, and Diamonds Are Forever.
